test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: A registered student account exists with known username and password
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> into the Username field
2. Enter <valid password> into the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard; login is successful; the Username field value is retained in session UI (e.g., user name displayed) and the password field is cleared from the login form

test_cases.test_case: Submit login using Enter key after filling fields
preconditions: A registered student account exists with known username and password
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> into the Username field
2. Enter <valid password> into the Password field
3. With focus in the Password field, press Enter/Return
test_cases.expected_result: Login is submitted and user is redirected to the Dashboard (same result as clicking 'Log in')

test_cases.test_case: Access the site as a guest using 'Access as a guest' button
steps: 1. Locate and click the 'Access as a guest' button in the separate section
test_cases.expected_result: The site opens a guest browsing view (e.g., course list or guest-accessible page); user is not authenticated and can browse permitted content as a guest

test_cases.test_case: Open Cookies notice from the login page
steps: 1. Click the 'Cookies notice' button
test_cases.expected_result: A cookies information panel or modal is displayed describing cookie usage; the login form remains visible behind or under the notice

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> into the Username field
2. Enter <incorrect password> into the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is displayed indicating invalid login; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains the entered username so the user can correct it

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with an empty Username field
steps: 1. Leave the Username field empty
2. Enter <any password> into the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is displayed indicating that credentials are invalid or missing; the Password field is cleared; the Username field remains empty for correction

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with an empty Password field
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> into the Username field
2. Leave the Password field empty
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is displayed indicating that credentials are invalid or missing; the Password field remains cleared; the Username field retains the entered username

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with both Username and Password fields empty
steps: 1. Leave the Username field empty
2. Leave the Password field empty
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is displayed indicating missing credentials; password field remains empty; username remains empty; no navigation occurs

test_cases.test_case: Click the 'Lost password?' link on a site where it is disabled
preconditions: On this test site the 'Lost password?' link is disabled
steps: 1. Locate and click the 'Lost password?' link
test_cases.expected_result: The link is visible but disabled/unresponsive; no password-reset page is opened; optionally a tooltip or disabled attribute is present indicating the feature is not available

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with Username field containing only whitespace characters
steps: 1. Enter one or more whitespace characters (spaces or tabs) into the Username field
2. Enter <any password> into the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: The system treats the Username as missing/invalid and displays an inline error; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains the entered whitespace so the tester can see what was entered (and correct it)

test_cases.test_case: Click the 'Log in' button repeatedly (rapid multiple clicks) after entering valid credentials
preconditions: A registered student account exists with known username and password
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> into the Username field
2. Enter <valid password> into the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button rapidly multiple times (2-5 times)
test_cases.expected_result: Only a single login submission is processed and the user is redirected to the Dashboard; multiple clicks do not cause duplicate navigations or visible duplicate submissions

test_cases.test_case: Paste a password from clipboard into the Password field and submit
preconditions: A registered student account exists with known username and password
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> into the Username field
2. Paste <valid password> into the Password field from the clipboard
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: Pasted password is accepted; the user is redirected to the Dashboard when credentials match; the password input remains masked while typing/pasted

test_cases.test_case: Dashboard displays personalized greeting
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard from the site or course navigation
test_cases.expected_result: A personalized greeting is displayed at the top of the Dashboard including the student's name or preferred name

test_cases.test_case: Timeline shows upcoming activities within selected time range
preconditions: User enrolled in at least one course with activities due within the next 7 days
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Timeline block, select 'Next 7 days' from the time range dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: The Timeline lists all upcoming activities and deadlines across enrolled courses that fall within the next 7 days

test_cases.test_case: Change Timeline sort order
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Timeline block, open the sort order dropdown and select a different sort option (e.g., by course or by date descending)
test_cases.expected_result: Timeline items reorder according to the selected sort option

test_cases.test_case: Search Timeline by activity name
preconditions: Timeline contains an activity with name containing 'Quiz 1'
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Timeline block, enter 'Quiz 1' in the search field and press Enter or click search
test_cases.expected_result: Timeline displays only activities whose name or type matches 'Quiz 1'; non-matching items are hidden

test_cases.test_case: Timeline empty state when no items in selected range
preconditions: No activities are due within the selected time range
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Timeline block, select the time range that contains no activities (e.g., Next 7 days)
test_cases.expected_result: An empty state message is shown in the Timeline block indicating there are no upcoming activities within the selected range

test_cases.test_case: Calendar shows current month/year and highlights current date
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. Observe the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: Calendar heading displays the current month and year; the current date is visually highlighted in the month view

test_cases.test_case: Filter Calendar by a single course using 'All courses' dropdown
preconditions: User enrolled in Course A which has calendar events this month
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Calendar block, open the 'All courses' dropdown and select 'Course A'
test_cases.expected_result: Calendar displays only events associated with Course A; other courses' events are hidden

test_cases.test_case: Create a personal calendar entry using 'New event'
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Calendar block, click 'New event'
3. Fill in required fields (title, date/time) and save the event
test_cases.expected_result: Personal event is saved and immediately appears on the calendar on the selected date; event name is shown inline on the date

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to create a new calendar event with empty title
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Calendar block, click 'New event'
3. Leave the Title field empty, fill other required fields, and click Save
test_cases.expected_result: An inline validation error is shown indicating the Title is required; event is not created

test_cases.test_case: Create event with very long title and description
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. Click 'New event' in the Calendar block
3. Enter a title of maximum allowed length (e.g., 255 characters) and a long description, then save
test_cases.expected_result: Event is accepted (or trimmed per system limits) and appears on the calendar; UI truncates or wraps the displayed event name appropriately without layout breakage

test_cases.test_case: Navigate calendar months using left/right arrows
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Calendar block, click the right arrow to move to the next month, then click the left arrow to return
test_cases.expected_result: Calendar heading updates to the next month when right arrow clicked and returns to the original month when left arrow clicked; events for the selected month are displayed

test_cases.test_case: Navigate calendar across year boundary (December to January)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard when the calendar shows December (or use left/right arrows until December is shown)
2. Click the right arrow to move to January of the next year
test_cases.expected_result: Calendar updates to show January of the following year and the heading shows the new year; no date highlight or rendering errors occur

test_cases.test_case: Dates with events display event names inline
preconditions: At least one calendar event exists on a specific date
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. Observe the calendar grid for dates that have events
test_cases.expected_result: Dates that have events show the event names inline within the date cell; clicking the event opens its details

test_cases.test_case: Open Full calendar from Dashboard
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. Click the 'Full calendar' link at the bottom of the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: The dedicated full calendar view opens (new page or view) showing the calendar with navigation and filters

test_cases.test_case: Open 'Import or export calendars' from Dashboard
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. Click the 'Import or export calendars' link at the bottom of the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: The calendar import/export management page opens and displays import/export options

test_cases.test_case: Toggle Edit mode and see edit controls and Add/Reset options
preconditions: User logged in as Student with permission to toggle Edit mode
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. Toggle Edit mode on (click Edit mode)
3. Observe the top-right and below-heading areas and existing blocks
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Reset page to default' button appears at the top right; a '+ Add a block' button appears below the Dashboard heading; each existing block displays a move icon and a three-dot menu with Configure, Move, and Delete actions

test_cases.test_case: Cancel block deletion in Edit mode retains block on page
preconditions: User logged in as Student with Edit mode enabled
Dashboard contains at least one block
steps: 1. Toggle Edit mode on
2. On an existing block, open the three-dot menu and select Delete
3. When the delete confirmation dialog appears, click Cancel
test_cases.expected_result: The block remains on the Dashboard; no deletion occurs and no error is shown

test_cases.test_case: Timeline search with special/SQL-like characters does not break the UI and returns safe results
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard
2. In the Timeline search field, enter a string with special characters or SQL-like pattern (e.g., "'; DROP TABLE activities; --") and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: The Timeline search handles the input safely: UI does not crash, no server error is shown; either no results are returned or matching items are shown; input is treated as literal text and properly escaped

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to a course by clicking the course name
preconditions: At least one course card is visible on My Courses page
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Identify a visible course card
3. Click the course name link on that card
test_cases.expected_result: The browser navigates to the selected course's main page (course header and navigation are displayed).

test_cases.test_case: Star a course using the three-dot menu pins it to the top
preconditions: At least two course cards visible, none starred initially
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. On a course card that is not at the top, click the three-dot menu
3. Select 'Star this course' from the menu
test_cases.expected_result: The selected course is visually indicated as starred (icon/state) and moves to the top of the course grid/list (Starred courses appear above others).

test_cases.test_case: Remove a course from view and find it under Hidden status
preconditions: At least one course card visible
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. On a course card, click the three-dot menu
3. Select 'Remove from view'
4. Verify the card disappears from current view
5. From the status dropdown, select 'Hidden'
test_cases.expected_result: The removed course is not visible in the default view but appears when the status filter is set to 'Hidden'.

test_cases.test_case: Filter courses by status 'In progress' using the status dropdown
preconditions: There are courses with varying statuses (In progress, Future, Past)
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the status dropdown above the grid
3. Select 'In progress'
test_cases.expected_result: Only courses with status 'In progress' are shown; other courses are filtered out.

test_cases.test_case: Change layout from Card to List and Summary using the layout dropdown
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the layout dropdown (default 'Card')
3. Select 'List' and observe layout
4. Open the layout dropdown again and select 'Summary' and observe layout
test_cases.expected_result: Selecting 'List' changes the presentation to a list view; selecting 'Summary' changes to the summary view. Course information is displayed appropriately in each layout.

test_cases.test_case: Sort courses using the sort dropdown (e.g., by name A-Z)
preconditions: At least two courses with different names
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the sort dropdown above the grid
3. Select 'Name (A-Z)' or equivalent sort option
test_cases.expected_result: Course cards are reordered according to the selected sort option (e.g., alphabetically A-Z).

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access My Courses while not logged in
preconditions: User is logged out (no active session)
steps: 1. Navigate directly to the My Courses page URL
test_cases.expected_result: The user is redirected to the Moodle login page (or shown a login prompt). Access to the My Courses content is not granted.

test_cases.test_case: Verify a course removed from view is not clickable from the default view
preconditions: At least one course present and removed from view via three-dot menu
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Remove a course from view using the three-dot menu -> 'Remove from view'
3. Ensure the status dropdown is set to 'All' (default)
4. Try to find and click the removed course card in the default list
test_cases.expected_result: The removed course card is not present in the default view and therefore cannot be clicked; no link to the course appears. The course remains hidden until 'Hidden' status is selected.

test_cases.test_case: Enter a malicious or malformed search string and verify the UI handles it safely
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Enter a string containing special characters or script-like payload (e.g., '<script>alert(1)</script>' or SQL-like input) into the search field
3. Press Enter or click the Search action
test_cases.expected_result: The system treats the input as search text (no script execution or injection); either shows matching course(s) if applicable or a safe 'no results' state. No UI crash or unexpected behavior occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Switch layout with a very large number of courses (e.g., 200) to check rendering
preconditions: User enrolled in a large number of courses (e.g., 200)
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the layout dropdown and select 'Card', then 'List', then 'Summary', observing each change
test_cases.expected_result: The page updates to each selected layout without visual corruption or functional loss. Courses are displayed (possibly paginated or lazy-loaded) and the layout controls remain responsive.

test_cases.test_case: Search with case-insensitive and partial match terms
preconditions: At least one course with a known name containing mixed case
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Enter a partial substring of a course name in a different case (e.g., 'bio' for 'Biology 101') in the search field
3. Press Enter or click Search
test_cases.expected_result: Search returns the matching course(s) regardless of case and matches partial substrings (case-insensitive/partial match behavior is tolerated).

test_cases.test_case: Filter to 'Starred' when no courses are starred
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the status dropdown and select 'Starred'
test_cases.expected_result: An empty state is displayed indicating there are no starred courses (no errors); user can switch back to another status to see courses.

test_cases.test_case: Course card with an extremely long course name does not break layout
preconditions: At least one course with an extremely long name present (e.g., 300+ characters)
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Observe the rendering of the card containing the long course name in Card, List, and Summary layouts
test_cases.expected_result: The long course name is handled gracefully (truncated with ellipsis or wrapped according to design) and does not overlap other UI elements or break the grid/list layout.

test_cases.test_case: View Course page header, navigation tabs and section list
preconditions: Student is enrolled in a course with at least one section
steps: 1. From the Dashboard, navigate to the Course page
2. Observe the page header and top area
test_cases.expected_result: The course name appears as the page heading; the navigation tab bar is visible below the heading; the main content lists course sections each showing a collapsible chevron and the section name

test_cases.test_case: Expand a collapsed section using the chevron
preconditions: Course page has a section that is currently collapsed and contains activities or resources
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Locate a collapsed section in the main content area
3. Click the section's chevron (expand control)
test_cases.expected_result: The selected section expands and displays its list of activities and resources; each item shows a type icon and a clickable name

test_cases.test_case: Open an activity/resource from a section
preconditions: Course contains at least one visible activity/resource in an expanded section
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page and expand the section containing the activity/resource
2. Click the activity/resource name
test_cases.expected_result: The browser navigates to the activity/resource page; the correct activity content loads and is accessible to the student

test_cases.test_case: Collapse all sections using the 'Collapse all' link
preconditions: Course page contains multiple sections and at least some are expanded
The 'Collapse all' link is visible at the top right of the sections area
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click the 'Collapse all' link located at the top right of the sections list
test_cases.expected_result: All course sections collapse at once; the content of each section is hidden and the chevrons indicate collapsed state

test_cases.test_case: Student attempts to enable Edit mode via UI (should not be available)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Inspect the page header and navigation area for any 'Turn editing on' or 'Edit mode' controls
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Turn editing on' / 'Edit mode' control is present for the student role; there is no UI affordance to enable editing

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access course edit page directly via URL as Student
preconditions: Student is on the course site and knows the edit URL (e.g., /course/edit.php?course=<id>)
steps: 1. From the browser address bar, enter the course edit page URL (direct access to the editing page) and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: Access is denied or the user is redirected with an appropriate permission error message; the student does not obtain editing controls

test_cases.test_case: Click an activity the student is not permitted to view
preconditions: Course contains an activity with access restrictions or prerequisite not met for this student
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page and expand the section containing the restricted activity
2. Click the restricted activity/resource name
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays an access-denied or 'you do not have permission' message; the activity content does not load

test_cases.test_case: Section name contains very long text and special characters
preconditions: Course contains a section with an extremely long name including special characters and punctuation
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Observe the display of the long-named section in the sections list
test_cases.expected_result: The long section name is displayed without breaking layout (it wraps or is truncated according to theme rules); the chevron remains visible and clickable and expanding/collapsing still works

test_cases.test_case: Use 'Collapse all' on a course with a very large number of sections
preconditions: Course contains a very large number of sections (e.g., 50-100)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click the 'Collapse all' link at the top right of the sections list
test_cases.expected_result: All sections collapse; the UI remains responsive and does not freeze or crash; chevrons for all sections indicate collapsed state

test_cases.test_case: Expand a section that contains no activities (empty section)
preconditions: Course contains at least one section with zero activities/resources
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Locate the empty section and click its chevron to expand it
test_cases.expected_result: The section expands but shows an empty state (no activity entries) or an explicit message indicating there are no activities; the expand/collapse control behaves normally

test_cases.test_case: Open Participants page and view participant list
preconditions: Course has at least one enrolled user
steps: 1. From the Course page, click the 'Participants' link in the navigation
2. Observe the Participants page header and the participants table
test_cases.expected_result: Participants page loads successfully and displays the participants table with columns: checkbox, First/Last name, Roles, Groups, Last access to course. Alphabetical filters (All, A–Z), filter controls (Any toggle, Select attribute dropdown, + Add condition link) and Clear filters / Apply filters buttons are visible

test_cases.test_case: Filter participants by the first-name alphabetical A button
preconditions: Course contains participants whose first names begin with 'A' and others
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. In the First name alphabetical filter, click the 'A' button
test_cases.expected_result: The participants table updates to show only participants whose first name begins with 'A'; if any matching participants exist they are listed, otherwise an empty state is shown

test_cases.test_case: Filter participants by role using Select attribute and Apply filters
preconditions: Course has participants with different roles (e.g., Student, Teacher)
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. In the filter area, open the Select attribute dropdown
3. Select 'Role' (or equivalent) and choose 'Student' as the value
4. Click 'Apply filters'
test_cases.expected_result: Participants table refreshes and displays only users who have the 'Student' role; the filter summary shows the active Role = Student condition

test_cases.test_case: Add multiple filter conditions and toggle 'Any' to show union results
preconditions: Course has participants matching different attributes (e.g., some in Group A, some with role Student)
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. Click '+ Add condition' to add a second condition
3. For condition 1 select 'Group' equals 'Group A'
4. For condition 2 select 'Role' equals 'Student'
5. Ensure the 'Any' toggle is turned ON (meaning OR)
6. Click 'Apply filters'
test_cases.expected_result: Participants table displays users who are either in Group A OR have the Student role; the filter UI indicates two conditions and 'Any' is active

test_cases.test_case: Open a participant's profile by clicking their name
preconditions: At least one participant is listed on the Participants page
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. In the participants table, click on any participant's First/Last name link
test_cases.expected_result: The participant's profile page opens in the same tab (or configured target); profile information is displayed and the Student user can view but not edit enrollment or role settings

test_cases.test_case: Sort participants by Last access column
preconditions: Participants page displays a Last access to course column with varying timestamps
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. Click the 'Last access to course' column header to sort ascending
3. Click the same column header again to sort descending
test_cases.expected_result: The table rows reorder according to Last access timestamp when sorting; header indicates current sort order and the list remains responsive

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to enrol or unenrol a user as a Student via the Participants page
steps: 1. Observe the participants table and any action menus or buttons (e.g., settings menu, 'Enrol users', 'Unenrol')
2. Try to find or click an 'Enrol users' or 'Unenrol' option in the participants page UI
3. Try to select a participant checkbox and look for bulk enrol/unenrol actions
test_cases.expected_result: Enrolment management actions ('Enrol users', 'Unenrol', 'Edit roles') are not available to the Student. No enrol/unenrol actions are present or are disabled; selecting checkboxes does not present bulk enrol/unenrol options

test_cases.test_case: Verify enrollment management options are not visible in any participants settings menu for Student
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. Open any settings or action menu associated with the participants list (e.g., gear icon, three-dot menu)
3. Search inside the menu for options like 'Enrol users', 'Unenrol users', 'Assign roles' or 'Enrollment methods'
test_cases.expected_result: None of the enrollment management or role-assignment options are visible in the menu for the Student role; the menu contains only view-level options if any

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to apply a filter condition with a required value left empty
steps: 1. Click '+ Add condition' in the filter area
2. Set the attribute to 'First name contains' (or similar) but leave the value input empty
3. Click 'Apply filters'
test_cases.expected_result: The system prevents applying the incomplete condition: either an inline validation message prompts to enter a value or Apply filters produces no results and a clear indication that the condition is incomplete. No unhandled error occurs

test_cases.test_case: Apply a combination of filters that returns zero participants
preconditions: Course exists but no user matches the improbable combination of conditions to be set
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. Add multiple conditions that together are unlikely to match any participant (e.g., Role = Teacher AND Group = 'NonexistentGroup' AND First name contains 'ZzzNonexistent')
3. Click 'Apply filters'
test_cases.expected_result: The participants table shows an empty state message indicating no participants match the selected filters; filter controls show active conditions and the page remains responsive

test_cases.test_case: Use an alphabetical filter letter that has no matching participants
preconditions: No participant's first or last name starts with the chosen letter (e.g., 'Q')
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. Click the alphabetical filter button for a letter with no matches (e.g., 'Q') for either First name or Last name
test_cases.expected_result: The participants table shows an empty state indicating no participants with names starting with the selected letter; alphabetical filter remains highlighted for the selected letter

test_cases.test_case: Filter using an extremely long input string for a name value
steps: 1. Open the Participants page
2. In the filter area choose 'First name contains'
3. Paste a very long string (e.g., 5000 characters) into the value field
4. Click 'Apply filters'
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the input without crashing; either the filter returns no results or truncates/handles the input gracefully and displays no error other than possibly a validation note. The UI remains responsive and stable

test_cases.test_case: Grades page displays expected columns
preconditions: Course exists with at least one graded activity and one ungraded activity
Student is enrolled in the course
steps: 1. From the Course page, click on 'Grades' in the course navigation
2. Observe the grade table
test_cases.expected_result: Grade table is visible and contains columns: Grade item, Calculated weight, Grade, Range, Percentage, Feedback, Contribution to course total

test_cases.test_case: Expand and collapse course header to show/hide graded activities
preconditions: Grades page shows the course name as a collapsible header with nested graded activities
steps: 1. Navigate to the Grades page
2. Click the course name collapsible header to expand
3. Verify that graded activities are displayed indented beneath the header
4. Click the course name header again to collapse
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking the header expands to show individual graded activities; clicking again collapses them and hides the activity rows

test_cases.test_case: Display of graded and ungraded items (numeric grade vs '–')
preconditions: Course has at least one item graded (e.g., 18/20) and one item not yet graded
Student has a recorded grade for the graded item
steps: 1. Open the Grades page for the course
2. Locate the graded activity row and the ungraded activity row
test_cases.expected_result: Graded activity shows the earned value (e.g., '18 / 20') in the Grade column and the corresponding Range and Percentage; ungraded activity shows '–' in the Grade column and shows Range but blank or placeholder for percentage/feedback as appropriate

test_cases.test_case: Aggregation Course total shows correct weighted cumulative grade
preconditions: Course has multiple graded items with known weights and grades (for example: Assignment A weight 50% grade 80/100, Assignment B weight 50% grade 60/100)
Student has recorded grades for those items
steps: 1. Navigate to the Grades page
2. Note each item's calculated weight, grade and percentage
3. Verify the 'AGGREGATION Course total' row at the bottom
test_cases.expected_result: The Aggregation Course total row displays the cumulative weighted grade computed from the items (with the example above: Course total = (80 * 0.5) + (60 * 0.5) = 70 or 70%), and the Contribution to course total column reflects each item's contribution; displayed value matches the calculated expected value

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to view another student's grades by changing URL parameters
preconditions: User logged in as Student A
Tester knows or guesses the URL pattern which might include a user id parameter for the grades report
steps: 1. Navigate to the Grades page as Student A
2. Modify the URL parameter that identifies the user (e.g., change userid=<A> to userid=<B>) and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: Access is denied or the page redirects to Student A's own grades; grades for other students are not displayed. No sensitive information about other students is revealed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access the full gradebook or reports restricted to instructors
preconditions: A full gradebook/report page exists for instructors (e.g., grade/report/index.php or grade/report/user/index.php)
Student does not have teacher/manager permissions
steps: 1. From the Student account, attempt to navigate to the full gradebook via any UI link if present
2. If no link exists, attempt to navigate directly by entering the known URL for the gradebook/report
test_cases.expected_result: Access is blocked: page shows 'Access denied' or 'You do not have permission' or redirects away; student cannot view other students' grades or instructor-only reports

test_cases.test_case: No edit controls present for student to modify grades
steps: 1. Open the Grades page
2. Inspect each grade row and header for any edit controls (e.g., edit icons, links labeled 'Edit' or 'Override')
3. Attempt to click any found edit control (if any) or attempt to submit an edit action if a control is discoverable
test_cases.expected_result: No edit controls are present for the student; if an edit action is attempted it is prevented and displays an error or permission denied message. Student cannot modify grades via UI

test_cases.test_case: Display of very long feedback text for an activity
preconditions: An activity contains very long feedback (e.g., >2000 characters) associated with the student's grade
steps: 1. Navigate to the Grades page
2. Locate the activity row and view the Feedback column content
test_cases.expected_result: Long feedback is displayed without breaking the layout: text either wraps, is truncated with a 'show more' control, or is scrollable; no overlap or broken table layout occurs and content is readable

test_cases.test_case: Items with calculated weight of 0% show zero contribution
preconditions: Course contains at least one grade item with Calculated weight = 0%
Student has a grade for that item
steps: 1. Open the Grades page
2. Locate the item with 0% calculated weight and inspect Contribution to course total and Aggregation
test_cases.expected_result: The item shows Calculated weight '0%' and Contribution to course total displays '0' or '0%' (no effect on Aggregation); Aggregation Course total does not include contribution from the zero-weight item

test_cases.test_case: Boundary grade values (0 and maximum) and percentage rounding
preconditions: Course has at least two items: one with grade 0 (e.g., 0/20), and one with maximum (e.g., 20/20)
Weights are set so that aggregation will display fractional percentages requiring rounding
steps: 1. Navigate to the Grades page
2. Verify the grade, percentage for the 0-score item (should show 0% or corresponding fraction)
3. Verify the grade, percentage for the max-score item (should show 100%)
4. Verify Aggregation shows correctly rounded percentage values according to site rounding rules
test_cases.expected_result: 0-grade item shows 0 (and 0%); max-grade item shows full marks (and 100%); Aggregation and Percentage columns display correctly calculated and appropriately rounded values without incorrect truncation

test_cases.test_case: Submit an assignment using the online text editor
preconditions: Assignment configured to accept online text submissions
Current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click the Assignment link to open the Assignment page
3. Verify Opened date, Due date and Description are visible
4. Click 'Add submission'
5. Enter 'This is my assignment submission' in the online text editor
6. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: Submission status updates to 'Submitted for grading'; 'Last modified' timestamp reflects submission time; Submission content is viewable in the submission area; Time remaining shows correct value

test_cases.test_case: Submit an assignment by uploading one or more files
preconditions: Assignment configured to accept file submissions
At least one allowed file type is available and file size is below site/course limit
Current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page from the Course page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Use the file upload area to attach file 'essay.docx'
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: Submission status updates to 'Submitted for grading'; uploaded file 'essay.docx' is listed in the submission area; 'Last modified' timestamp is updated; Time remaining shows correct value

test_cases.test_case: Submit an assignment using both online text editor and file upload
preconditions: Assignment configured to accept both online text and file uploads
Current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Enter text in the online editor and attach a file 'diagram.png'
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: Both the entered text and the attached file are displayed in the submission summary; Submission status shows 'Submitted for grading'; 'Last modified' timestamp updated

test_cases.test_case: Edit a submitted assignment before the Due date when resubmission is permitted
preconditions: Student has already submitted an assignment
Teacher permits resubmission and current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. In the Submission status section, click 'Edit submission' or equivalent action
3. Modify the online text or replace uploaded files
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: Submission updates reflect the edited content/files; 'Last modified' timestamp updates to the edit time; Submission status remains 'Submitted for grading' (or as configured); student can view the revised submission

test_cases.test_case: View grade and teacher feedback after grading
preconditions: Assignment has been graded by the teacher
Grade and/or written feedback have been posted
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Scroll to the Submission status / Feedback section
test_cases.expected_result: Earned grade is displayed alongside grade scale (if applicable); teacher's written feedback is visible in the feedback area; any feedback files are downloadable

test_cases.test_case: Assignment page displays Opened date, Due date and full Description
preconditions: Assignment exists with Opened date, Due date and Description set
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click the Assignment link to open the Assignment page
test_cases.expected_result: The Assignment page shows the Opened date, Due date and the complete Description text (no truncation); Time remaining is shown if applicable

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to submit when a file upload is required but no file is attached
preconditions: Assignment configured to require at least one file upload
Current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Do not attach any files
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the submission and displays an inline error message indicating that a file upload is required; submission is not accepted

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to submit after the Due date when late submissions are not accepted
preconditions: Current time is after the Assignment Due date
Assignment is configured to not accept late submissions
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Add text or upload a file
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: The system prevents submission and displays an error or notice that submissions are closed due to the past due date; no submission is recorded

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to upload a file that exceeds the maximum allowed file size
preconditions: Assignment configured to accept file uploads
A file larger than the course/site maximum upload size is available
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Attempt to attach an oversized file
4. Click 'Save changes' if required by the UI
test_cases.expected_result: The upload is rejected and an error message is shown indicating the file is too large; the oversized file is not attached and the submission is not accepted until a valid file is provided

test_cases.test_case: Submit with an empty online text editor when empty submissions are allowed
preconditions: Assignment configured to accept online text and permits empty submissions
Current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Leave the online text editor blank
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is accepted even though the online text is empty; Submission status updates to 'Submitted for grading' and 'Last modified' timestamp is set; student sees an explicit note (if configured) that the submission contains no text

test_cases.test_case: Upload a file with a filename containing special characters and unicode
preconditions: Assignment configured to accept file uploads
A test file named 'résumé_测试_#1.pdf' is available and within size limits
Current time is before the Due date
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page
2. Click 'Add submission'
3. Attach the file 'résumé_测试_#1.pdf'
4. Click 'Save changes'
test_cases.expected_result: File uploads successfully and is listed with its filename preserved or safely encoded; submission is accepted and downloadable without corrupting the filename or content

test_cases.test_case: View Time remaining when the Due date is exactly the current time (boundary)
preconditions: Assignment Due date is set to the current time (boundary condition)
steps: 1. Open the Assignment page at the moment the Due date equals current time
2. Observe the Time remaining and Submission options
test_cases.expected_result: The Time remaining displays zero or an 'Due now' indicator; submission controls behave according to late submission policy (either last-moment submission accepted or rejected) and UI reflects the correct state

test_cases.test_case: Assignments section is expanded by default and displays required columns
preconditions: Course contains at least one assignment
steps: 1. Navigate to the course page
2. Click the 'Activities' link/menu to open the Activities page
test_cases.expected_result: The Assignments section is expanded by default and displays a table with columns 'Name' (each entry is a clickable link and shows parent section below the name), 'Due date', and 'Submission status'

test_cases.test_case: Expand collapsed activity sections (Forums and Resources)
preconditions: Course contains at least one forum and one resource
steps: 1. Locate the Forums section (collapsed by default)
2. Click the expand arrow for Forums
3. Locate the Resources section (collapsed by default)
4. Click the expand arrow for Resources
test_cases.expected_result: Both Forums and Resources sections expand to reveal their contained activities; each revealed activity displays a clickable Name link

test_cases.test_case: Click an activity name navigates to that activity's page and shows parent section
preconditions: Course contains an activity (assignment, forum, or resource) with a valid activity page
steps: 1. In the Activities page, locate an activity listed under any section
2. Click the activity Name link
test_cases.expected_result: The browser navigates to the activity's page; the activity page loads successfully and the activity's parent section (course section/module location) is shown beneath the activity name as on the Activities page

test_cases.test_case: Additional activity types appear as their own collapsible sections
preconditions: Course contains activity types other than Assignments, Forums, and Resources (e.g., Quizzes, Workshops)
steps: 1. Scroll through the Activities page
2. Identify sections for each additional activity type
3. Click the expand arrow for one additional activity type
test_cases.expected_result: Each additional activity type is displayed as its own collapsible section; expanding the section reveals its activities with clickable Name links

test_cases.test_case: Submission status displays correct state for a submitted assignment
preconditions: Course contains an assignment with a submission made by the student
steps: 1. Navigate to the Assignments section of the Activities page
2. Locate the row for the submitted assignment
test_cases.expected_result: The Submission status column for that assignment shows the appropriate state (e.g., 'Submitted for grading' or 'Submitted'); Due date and Name are shown correctly

test_cases.test_case: Assignment with no due date displays 'No due date' (or equivalent)
preconditions: Course contains an assignment that has no due date set
steps: 1. Navigate to the Assignments section
2. Locate the assignment that has no due date
test_cases.expected_result: The Due date column for the assignment displays an explicit indicator such as 'No due date' or empty state text instead of a date

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access Activities page as a user not enrolled in the course
preconditions: User logged in as Student who is not enrolled in the target course
steps: 1. From Dashboard or course list, attempt to open the Activities page for the course the user is not enrolled in
test_cases.expected_result: Access is denied or the Activities page is not available; the system shows an authorization error or redirects to an appropriate page (e.g., enrolment/purchase information)

test_cases.test_case: Click activity link that points to a deleted/missing activity (broken link)
preconditions: Course Activities page lists an activity whose target page has been deleted or moved resulting in a broken link
steps: 1. Locate the activity with the broken link on the Activities page
2. Click the activity Name link
test_cases.expected_result: An error page or a clear message is displayed indicating the activity cannot be found (e.g., 404 or 'Module not found'); the Activities page remains accessible

test_cases.test_case: Activities page fails to load due to network error
preconditions: Network connectivity is interrupted or the server returns an error when requesting the Activities page
steps: 1. Attempt to open the Activities page while simulating a network/server error
test_cases.expected_result: The UI shows an appropriate load failure message or error state (e.g., 'Unable to load activities' or generic network error); the page does not display incomplete/incorrect activity lists

test_cases.test_case: Very long activity name and parent section text display and remain clickable
preconditions: Course contains an activity with an extremely long Name and long parent section text
steps: 1. Locate the activity with the long Name in the appropriate section
2. Verify how the long text is rendered (wrapped, truncated with ellipsis)
3. Click the activity Name link
test_cases.expected_result: The long Name and parent section text render without breaking the layout (either wrapped or truncated with ellipsis); the Name remains clickable and navigates to the activity page

test_cases.test_case: Activities page with a very large number of activities handles scrolling and expand/collapse
preconditions: Course contains a very large number of activities across multiple types (hundreds)
steps: 1. Scroll through the Activities page from top to bottom
2. Expand and collapse several sections (Assignments, Forums, Resources, and other types)
3. Click a few activity Name links at different positions in the list
test_cases.expected_result: The page remains responsive; a scrollbar appears if necessary; expand/collapse actions work for all sections; clicking activity links navigates to the correct activity pages

test_cases.test_case: Activities with duplicate names and special characters resolve to the correct activity page
preconditions: Course contains multiple activities that share the same Name or contain special characters (e.g., emojis, non-Latin script)
steps: 1. Identify two or more activities with identical or similar Names (or containing special characters)
2. For each listed activity, note the shown parent section beneath the name to disambiguate
3. Click the Name link for each activity and verify destination
test_cases.expected_result: Each click navigates to the correct, distinct activity page; parent section text correctly disambiguates duplicate names; special characters render correctly in the list and on the activity pages

test_cases.test_case: View Profile page shows core elements
preconditions: Profile page for the logged-in student is available
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course/Dashboard and open the student's Profile page
2. Observe the top area of the Profile page
test_cases.expected_result: The page displays the circular initials icon, the student's full name, a 'Message' button, and the profile description (if present). Information cards for User details, Privacy and policies, Course details, Miscellaneous, Reports, and Login activity are visible

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Message' opens messaging to that student
preconditions: Profile page for another enrolled student is open
steps: 1. On the profile page, click the 'Message' button
2. Wait for the messaging composer/modal to open
test_cases.expected_result: A messaging composer opens addressed to the profile owner, allowing the student to type and send a message

test_cases.test_case: Open 'Edit profile' form and view collapsible panels
preconditions: On the student's own Profile page
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit profile' link in the User details card
2. Wait for the profile edit form to load and examine the presence of collapsible panels
test_cases.expected_result: The profile form opens showing collapsible panels for General, User picture, Additional names, Interests, and Optional fields; fields listed in the General panel are present (First name, Last name, Email address, Email visibility dropdown, MoodleNet profile ID, City/town, Country dropdown, Timezone dropdown, Description)

test_cases.test_case: Update profile with valid changes and save
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Expand the General panel if collapsed
2. Change City/town to a valid value and select a different Timezone from the dropdown
3. Modify the Description field with valid text
4. Click 'Update profile' and confirm/save
test_cases.expected_result: Form validates inputs and saves changes; the Profile page reloads (or updates) showing the new City/town, Timezone, and Description and a confirmation message or indication that profile was updated

test_cases.test_case: Upload a new profile picture with a supported image file
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
A valid image file (e.g., PNG or JPG) available for upload
steps: 1. Open the User picture panel
2. Use the upload control to select and upload a valid image file
3. Enter an optional picture description
4. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: The image is accepted, uploaded, and displayed as the current picture on the Profile page; the picture description is saved and displayed where applicable; no error is shown

test_cases.test_case: Cancel Edit profile exits without saving changes
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Make visible changes to the Description or City field
2. Click the 'Cancel' button
3. Return to the Profile page
test_cases.expected_result: No changes are saved; the Profile page shows the original values that were present before editing

test_cases.test_case: Course details links navigate to enrolled course profiles
preconditions: Profile page lists enrolled courses in the Course details card
steps: 1. In the Course details card, click one of the enrolled course profile links
2. Observe navigation to the target course profile page
test_cases.expected_result: The system navigates to the selected course's profile or course page corresponding to that link

test_cases.test_case: Reports links open Browser sessions and Grades overview
steps: 1. In the Reports card, click 'Browser sessions'
2. Return and click 'Grades overview'
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking 'Browser sessions' opens the browser session report for the student; clicking 'Grades overview' opens the student's grades overview report

test_cases.test_case: Login activity shows precise dates and relative time indicators
preconditions: Profile page has recorded first and last access times
steps: 1. Open the Profile page and locate the Login activity section
2. Inspect the displayed First access and Last access entries
test_cases.expected_result: Both First access and Last access display exact dates and times plus relative time indicators (e.g., '2 days ago'); values match the stored access timestamps

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to edit another student's profile (permission denied)
preconditions: Profile page of a different student is open
steps: 1. On another student's Profile page, attempt to click an 'Edit profile' link (if visible) or navigate to the edit URL for that user
2. Observe system response
test_cases.expected_result: The system prevents editing: no edit form is accessible or an authorization error is shown; the student can only view the profile and not modify it

test_cases.test_case: Try to update profile leaving a required field empty (First name)
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Expand the General panel
2. Clear the First name field so it is empty
3. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: The form does not save; an inline validation error is shown near the First name field indicating it is required; focus may remain on the field

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid email format and attempt to save
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Expand the General panel
2. Enter 'invalid-email' into the Email address field
3. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: The form validation rejects the input and displays an inline error indicating the email address is invalid; changes are not saved

test_cases.test_case: Upload an unsupported file type as profile picture
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
An unsupported file (e.g., .exe or .pdf) is available
steps: 1. Open the User picture panel
2. Attempt to upload an unsupported file type using the upload control
3. Click 'Update profile' if upload proceeds to that step
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the file upload and shows an error message about invalid file type or allowed file formats; picture is not changed

test_cases.test_case: Save an extremely long profile description (very large input)
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
A very large description string (e.g., 10,000 characters) prepared
steps: 1. Expand the General panel
2. Paste the very large description into the Description field
3. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: The system either accepts and stores the description or enforces a maximum length with a clear validation message; the UI remains responsive and does not corrupt other fields; if accepted, the Profile page shows the description (possibly truncated) without breaking layout

test_cases.test_case: Select an extreme timezone value (UTC+14 or UTC-12)
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Expand the General panel
2. Open the Timezone dropdown and select an extreme timezone such as UTC+14 or UTC-12
3. Click 'Update profile' and return to Profile page
test_cases.expected_result: The selected extreme timezone is accepted and displayed in the User details card; any time-related displays reflect the selected timezone appropriately

test_cases.test_case: Set email visibility to 'Hidden' and verify email is not shown publicly
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Expand the General panel
2. Set the Email visibility dropdown to the option that hides email from other users (e.g., 'Hidden')
3. Click 'Update profile'
4. Log out (or use another test student) and view the user's Profile page as another student
test_cases.expected_result: When viewed by other users, the email address is not visible on the profile page; the User details card indicates email visibility setting or a visibility note is present

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters and emojis in Additional names and Interests
preconditions: On the student's own Edit profile form
steps: 1. Open the Additional names and Interests panels
2. Enter names and interest entries containing special characters, accented letters, and emojis
3. Click 'Update profile' and view profile display
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts valid UTF-8 characters and displays them correctly on the Profile page without layout breakage or data corruption; if characters are disallowed a clear validation message appears

test_cases.test_case: Login activity where First and Last access timestamps are identical
preconditions: Profile's First access and Last access are identical (e.g., newly created account)
steps: 1. Open the Profile page and locate Login activity
2. Inspect the display for First access and Last access when timestamps match
test_cases.expected_result: The Login activity displays identical exact dates and relative time indicators appropriately (e.g., both show the same date/time and relative text like 'just now' or 'today'); no confusing duplicate labels are shown

test_cases.test_case: Log out from course page and verify redirect to login
preconditions: User is on a Course page
steps: 1. Click the user menu / profile menu in the page header
2. Click the 'Log out' link
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Moodle login page; attempting to navigate to any protected page prompts for authentication

test_cases.test_case: Log out then attempt to open a bookmarked protected URL
preconditions: A protected page (e.g., Dashboard) URL is bookmarked or available
steps: 1. Click 'Log out' from any page
2. Enter the bookmarked protected page URL into the browser address bar and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to the login page (not the protected content). The protected page requires re-authentication before access

test_cases.test_case: Log out in one tab and verify other open tab requires login
preconditions: User logged in as Student with the site open in two browser tabs (Tab A and Tab B)
steps: 1. In Tab A, click 'Log out'
2. Switch to Tab B and refresh the page or attempt navigation to another protected area
test_cases.expected_result: Tab B is redirected to the login page or presented with a login prompt; protected content is not accessible without signing in again

test_cases.test_case: Log out using mobile/responsive layout
preconditions: User logged in as Student on a mobile device or small viewport
steps: 1. Open the responsive/mobile menu
2. Tap 'Log out'
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; mobile UI shows login form and protected pages require re-authentication

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access a protected page after logging out without re-authenticating
preconditions: Protected page URL is known (e.g., assignment submission)
steps: 1. After logging out, enter the protected page URL in the address bar and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or sees an authentication required message; protected page content is not displayed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt an authenticated action (submit/grade) immediately after clicking Log out
preconditions: User logged in as Student with an assignment submission page open (form loaded)
steps: 1. Click 'Log out'
2. With the assignment submission form still open, attempt to submit the form or perform another action that requires authentication
test_cases.expected_result: The action is rejected; the user is redirected to the login page or shown a message that authentication is required; submission is not accepted

test_cases.test_case: Use browser back button after logging out to access previous protected page
preconditions: User logged in as Student and navigated to a protected page
steps: 1. After logging out and being redirected to the login page, click the browser Back button
test_cases.expected_result: Protected content is not accessible; either the login page is shown again or a message prompts re-authentication. The application does not expose authenticated content via the back button

test_cases.test_case: Click Log out when the server-side session has already expired
preconditions: User has a session that has expired on the server (e.g., long idle time) but browser still shows user as logged in
steps: 1. Click 'Log out' from any page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page without an error; no authenticated pages remain accessible and re-authentication is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log out while the network is offline
preconditions: Network connectivity can be toggled (set to offline)
steps: 1. Turn off network connectivity (airplane mode / disconnect)
2. Click 'Log out'
test_cases.expected_result: Either an inline/network error is displayed indicating logout failed OR the client clears local authentication state and shows the login page; in all cases, protected pages must require re-authentication when connectivity is restored
